title: Typing a value fills the empty ranges below in gray
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, four ranges, tier A on % Off with every range empty.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click matrix A's name on the Matrices list.
  3. Click Edit.
  4. Type 8 in tier A's first range.
  5. Type 12 in tier A's third range over the gray 8.
  6. Type 10 in tier A's first range.
  7. Click Save.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Matrix A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Matrix A's page opens.

Step 3:

  • The grid is in edit.

Step 4:

  • Tier A's ranges 2, 3 and 4 show 8 in gray.

Step 5:

  • Range 3 reads 12 in normal text; range 4 now shows 12 in gray.

Step 6:

  • Range 2 shows 10 in gray.
  • Range 3 keeps 12 and range 4 keeps the gray 12, not 10.

Step 7:

  • In view tier A reads 10% off, 10% off, 12% off and 12% off.
